verdict.rationale: Cekura's marketing mentions "live drift detection across every call" and says it "flags issues," which hints at detecting eval-score drops. There is no documentation of configurable alert rules or of routing notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, or email. Missing for 10: configurable alert thresholds on error rates, cost-spike alerts, eval-score-drop alert rules, Slack/PagerDuty/email notification integrations, first-party alerting docs, independent corroboration.
